effects.target: all sentient beings who hear it

evidence.locator: Any noise produced by SCP-513 immediately induces strong anxiety in all sentient beings who hear it, regardless of their previous mental status.

constraints: The person has been exposed to SCP-513

evidence.locator: Roughly one hour after exposure, exposure victims begin to catch glimpses of SCP-513-1 when opening doors, walking past mirrors, turning their heads, or performing any other actions that result in a sudden change in visual perception.

constraints: All test cases but one have ended with the test subject’s suicide

evidence.locator: This sleep deprivation, along with the mental stress caused by SCP-513-1's behavior, invariably induces paranoia, aggression, hypervigilance, and depression.
